runs.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct AS a JOIN dstr AS d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id WHERE a.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.a3 = 'East Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT acct.accn_id) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id JOIN ln ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE dstr.a3 = 'Prague'
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(a13) > AVG(a12) THEN '1996' ELSE '1995' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM dstr

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dstr.dstr_id)
FROM dstr
JOIN clnt ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE clnt.gndr = 'F'
  AND dstr.a11 > 6000
  AND dstr.a11 < 10000
SELECT COUNT(clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M' AND dstr.a3 = 'North Bohemia' AND dstr.a11 > 8000

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM dstr) AS salary_gap
FROM acct a
JOIN dsp dp ON a.accn_id = dp.ref2
JOIN clnt c ON dp.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
  AND c.brth_dt = (SELECT MIN(c2.brth_dt) FROM clnt c2 WHERE c2.gndr = 'F')
  AND d.a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM dstr)

SELECT acct.accn_id
FROM acct
JOIN dsp ON acct.accn_id = dsp.ref2
JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
ORDER BY clnt.brth_dt DESC, dstr.a11 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.clnt_id)
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2
WHERE a.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.typ = 'OWNER'
SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1 JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND dsp.typ = 'DISPONENT'

SELECT a.accn_id
FROM acct AS a
JOIN ln AS l ON a.accn_id = l.ref1
WHERE YEAR(l.dt) = 1997
  AND a.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY l.amnt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.accn_id
FROM acct a
JOIN ln l ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id
WHERE l.drtn > 12
  AND YEAR(a.dt) = 1993
ORDER BY l.amnt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.clnt_id)
FROM clnt c
JOIN dstr d ON c.ref1 = d.dstr_id
JOIN dsp p ON p.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = p.ref2
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
  AND c.brth_dt < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.a2 = 'Sokolov'
SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id FROM acct a JOIN trns t ON t.ref1 = a.accn_id WHERE t.dt = (SELECT MIN(dt) FROM trns WHERE YEAR(dt) = 1995)

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id
FROM acct AS a
JOIN ln AS l ON a.accn_id = l.ref1
WHERE a.dt < '1997-01-01' AND l.amnt > 3000

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
JOIN crd ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id
WHERE crd.issd = '1994-03-03'
SELECT acct.dt FROM trns JOIN acct ON trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE trns.amnt = 840 AND trns.dt = '1998-10-14'

SELECT dstr.dstr_id
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE ln.dt = '1994-08-25'
SELECT MAX(t.amnt) FROM trns AS t JOIN dsp AS d ON t.ref1 = d.ref2 JOIN crd AS c ON d.dsp_id = c.ref1 WHERE c.issd = '1996-10-21'

SELECT c.gndr
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr ds ON a.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE d.typ = 'OWNER'
AND ds.a11 = (SELECT MAX(a11) FROM dstr)
ORDER BY c.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.amnt
FROM trns t
WHERE t.ref1 = (
  SELECT l.ref1
  FROM ln l
  ORDER BY l.amnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY t.dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp dp ON dp.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = dp.ref2
JOIN dstr d ON d.dstr_id = a.ref1
WHERE d.a2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gndr = 'F'

SELECT DISTINCT dsp.dsp_id
FROM trns
JOIN acct ON trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
WHERE trns.amnt = 5100
  AND trns.dt = '1998-09-02'
SELECT COUNT(a.accn_id) FROM acct a JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id WHERE d.a2 = 'Litomerice' AND YEAR(a.dt) = 1996

SELECT DISTINCT ds.a2
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp dp ON c.clnt_id = dp.ref1
JOIN acct a ON dp.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr ds ON a.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
  AND c.brth_dt = '1976-01-29'

SELECT clnt.brth_dt
FROM ln
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = ln.ref1
JOIN clnt ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
WHERE ln.amnt = 98832 AND ln.dt = '1996-01-03'

SELECT acct.accn_id
FROM acct
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
WHERE dstr.a3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY acct.dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(c.gndr = 'M') / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM clnt c
JOIN dstr d ON c.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE d.dstr_id = (
    SELECT dstr_id
    FROM dstr
    WHERE a3 = 'South Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS UNSIGNED) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT ((end_b.blnc - start_b.blnc) / start_b.blnc) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT t.blnc
  FROM trns t
  WHERE t.ref1 = (SELECT ref1 FROM ln ORDER BY dt ASC, ln_id ASC LIMIT 1)
    AND t.dt = '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY t.trns_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS start_b,
(
  SELECT t.blnc
  FROM trns t
  WHERE t.ref1 = (SELECT ref1 FROM ln ORDER BY dt ASC, ln_id ASC LIMIT 1)
    AND t.dt = '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY t.trns_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS end_b
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN stts = 'A' THEN amnt ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amnt) * 100 AS percentage FROM ln
SELECT SUM(stts = 'C') * 100.0 / COUNT(ref1) AS percentage FROM ln WHERE amnt < 100000

SELECT acct.accn_id, dstr.a2, dstr.a3
FROM acct
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE YEAR(acct.dt) = 1993
  AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id, a.frqn
FROM acct a
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN clnt c ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN dstr ds ON ds.dstr_id = c.ref1
WHERE d.typ = 'OWNER'
AND ds.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
AND a.dt BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
SELECT acct.accn_id, acct.dt FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Prachatice'
SELECT dstr.a2, dstr.a3 FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE ln.ln_id = 4990
SELECT acct.accn_id, dstr.a2, dstr.a3 FROM acct JOIN ln ON acct.accn_id = ln.ref1 JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE ln.amnt > 300000
SELECT ln.ln_id, dstr.a2, dstr.a11 FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE ln.drtn = 60

SELECT ((dstr.a13 - dstr.a12) * 100 / dstr.a12) AS unemployment_increment
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE ln.stts = 'D'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dstr.a2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM acct
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE acct.dt >= '1993-01-01' AND acct.dt < '1994-01-01'
SELECT accn_id FROM acct WHERE frqn = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.a2, COUNT(c.clnt_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM dstr d
JOIN clnt c ON c.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
GROUP BY d.dstr_id, d.a2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.a2
FROM trns t
JOIN acct a ON t.ref1 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE t.typ = 'VYDAJ' AND t.dt LIKE '1996-01%'
ORDER BY t.amnt DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(dsp.ref2) FROM dsp JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a3 = 'South Bohemia' AND dsp.typ != 'OWNER'

SELECT d.a3
FROM dstr d
JOIN acct a ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
JOIN ln l ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id
WHERE l.stts IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.dstr_id, d.a3
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(ln.amnt) FROM ln JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = ln.ref1 JOIN clnt ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1 WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M'
SELECT dstr_id, a2 FROM dstr WHERE a13 = (SELECT MAX(a13) FROM dstr)

SELECT COUNT(accn_id) AS account_count
FROM acct
WHERE ref1 = (
    SELECT dstr_id
    FROM dstr
    ORDER BY a16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.accn_id) FROM acct a JOIN trns t ON a.accn_id = t.ref1 WHERE a.frqn = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND t.oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.blnc < 0
SELECT COUNT(ln.ln_id) FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND ln.dt BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND ln.amnt >= 250000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.accn_id) AS account_count
FROM acct a
JOIN ln l ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id
WHERE a.ref1 = 1 AND l.stts IN ('C','D')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clnt WHERE gndr = 'M' AND ref1 = (SELECT dstr_id FROM dstr ORDER BY a15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crd JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE crd.typ = 'gold' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT dstr.a2
FROM trns
JOIN acct ON trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE trns.amnt > 10000
AND trns.dt BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id
FROM acct a
JOIN ord o ON o.ref1 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE o.k_symb = 'SIPO' AND d.a2 = 'Pisek'
SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id FROM acct a JOIN dsp d ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id JOIN crd c ON c.ref1 = d.dsp_id WHERE c.typ = 'gold'

SELECT MONTH(dt) AS mnth, AVG(amnt) AS avg_amount
FROM trns
WHERE oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND YEAR(dt) = 2021
GROUP BY MONTH(dt)
ORDER BY mnth

SELECT DISTINCT c.clnt_id
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN trns t ON a.accn_id = t.ref1
WHERE t.oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.amnt < (SELECT AVG(t2.amnt) FROM trns t2 WHERE t2.oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU')
  AND YEAR(t.dt) = 1998
SELECT DISTINCT c.clnt_id FROM clnt c JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1 JOIN crd cr ON cr.ref1 = d.dsp_id JOIN ln l ON l.ref1 = d.ref2 WHERE c.gndr = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.accn_id)
FROM clnt AS c
JOIN dsp AS d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct AS a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr AS r ON a.ref1 = r.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F' AND r.a3 = 'south Bohemia'

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id
FROM acct a
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
JOIN dsp p ON p.ref2 = a.accn_id
WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor'
AND p.typ = 'OWNER'
SELECT dsp.typ FROM dsp JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dsp.typ <> 'OWNER' AND dstr.a11 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT acct.accn_id) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id JOIN trns ON acct.accn_id = trns.ref1 WHERE dstr.a3 = 'North Bohemia' AND trns.bnk = 'AB'

SELECT DISTINCT dstr.a2
FROM dstr
JOIN acct ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
JOIN trns ON trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id
WHERE trns.typ = 'VYDAJ'
SELECT AVG(a15) FROM dstr WHERE a15 > 4000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acct WHERE acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id AND acct.dt >= '1997-01-01')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crd JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE crd.typ = 'classic' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M' AND dstr.a2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN typ = 'Gold' AND issd < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent FROM crd

SELECT c.clnt_id
FROM ln l
JOIN dsp d ON l.ref1 = d.ref2
JOIN clnt c ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
WHERE d.typ = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY l.amnt DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT d.a15 FROM acct a JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id WHERE a.accn_id = 532
SELECT acct.ref1 FROM ord JOIN acct ON ord.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE ord.ordr_id = 33333

SELECT trns.trns_id, trns.ref1, trns.dt, trns.typ, trns.oprt, trns.amnt, trns.blnc, trns.k_symb, trns.bnk, trns.accn FROM trns WHERE trns.oprt = 'VYBER' AND trns.ref1 IN (SELECT dsp.ref2 FROM dsp WHERE dsp.ref1 = 3356)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.accn_id) FROM acct a JOIN ln l ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id WHERE a.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND l.amnt < 200000
SELECT crd.typ FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id JOIN crd ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 13539
SELECT dstr.a3 FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 3541

SELECT dstr.a2
FROM dstr
JOIN acct ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
JOIN ln ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
WHERE ln.stts = 'A'
GROUP BY dstr.dstr_id, dstr.a2
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT acct.accn_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT clnt.clnt_id FROM ord JOIN dsp ON ord.ref1 = dsp.ref2 JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id WHERE ord.ordr_id = 32423

SELECT trns.trns_id, trns.ref1, trns.dt, trns.typ, trns.oprt, trns.amnt, trns.blnc, trns.k_symb, trns.bnk, trns.accn
FROM trns
JOIN acct ON trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id
WHERE acct.ref1 = 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Jesenik'
SELECT DISTINCT dsp.ref1 AS clnt_id FROM crd JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE crd.typ = 'junior' AND crd.issd >= '1997-01-01'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gndr = 'F' THEN c.clnt_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.clnt_id) AS percentage
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2
JOIN dstr ds ON ds.dstr_id = a.ref1
WHERE ds.a11 > 10000

SELECT ((SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.dt) = 1997 THEN l.amnt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.dt) = 1996 THEN l.amnt ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.dt) = 1996 THEN l.amnt ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM ln AS l
JOIN acct AS a ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id
JOIN dsp AS d ON a.accn_id = d.ref2
JOIN clnt AS c ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'M' AND YEAR(l.dt) IN (1996, 1997)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM trns WHERE oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND YEAR(dt) > 1995
SELECT (SELECT SUM(a16) FROM dstr WHERE a3 = 'East Bohemia') - (SELECT SUM(a16) FROM dstr WHERE a3 = 'North Bohemia') AS difference
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dsp WHERE ref2 BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND typ IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT')

SELECT acct.frqn, ord.k_symb
FROM acct
JOIN ord ON acct.accn_id = ord.ref1
WHERE acct.accn_id = 3
GROUP BY acct.frqn, ord.k_symb
HAVING SUM(ord.amnt) = 3539
SELECT YEAR(brth_dt) FROM clnt WHERE clnt_id = 130
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.accn_id) FROM acct a JOIN dsp d ON a.accn_id = d.ref2 WHERE d.typ = 'OWNER' AND a.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT ln.amnt, ln.stts
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
JOIN ln ON ln.ref1 = dsp.ref2
WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 992

SELECT trns.blnc, clnt.gndr
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN trns ON dsp.ref2 = trns.ref1
WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 4 AND trns.trns_id = 851
SELECT DISTINCT crd.typ FROM crd JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE dsp.ref1 = 9

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(trns.amnt), 0) AS total_amount
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN trns ON acct.accn_id = trns.ref1
WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 617
  AND YEAR(trns.dt) = 1998

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id, acct.accn_id
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE clnt.brth_dt >= '1983-01-01'
  AND clnt.brth_dt <= '1987-12-31'
  AND dstr.a3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT c.clnt_id
FROM clnt AS c
JOIN dsp AS d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN ln AS l ON d.ref2 = l.ref1
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
GROUP BY c.clnt_id
ORDER BY MAX(l.amnt) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id JOIN acct ON acct.accn_id = dsp.ref2 JOIN ord ON ord.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M' AND YEAR(clnt.brth_dt) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND ord.k_symb = 'SIPO' AND ord.amnt > 4000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Beroun' AND YEAR(acct.dt) > 1996
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id JOIN crd ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'F' AND crd.typ = 'junior'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gndr = 'F' THEN c.clnt_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.clnt_id) * 100 AS proportion
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr ds ON a.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE ds.a3 = 'Prague'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN clnt.gndr = 'M' THEN clnt.clnt_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id) AS percentage FROM acct JOIN dsp ON acct.accn_id = dsp.ref2 JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsp.ref1) FROM dsp JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'

SELECT a.accn_id
FROM acct AS a
JOIN ln AS l ON a.accn_id = l.ref1
WHERE l.drtn > 24
  AND a.dt < '1997-01-01'
ORDER BY l.amnt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.accn_id
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr ds ON c.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
ORDER BY c.brth_dt ASC, ds.a11 ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE YEAR(clnt.brth_dt) = 1920 AND LOWER(dstr.a3) = 'east bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
WHERE ln.drtn = 24
  AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
SELECT AVG(ln.amnt) FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE ln.stts IN ('C', 'D') AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id, dstr.a2
FROM clnt
JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
WHERE dsp.typ = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT c.clnt_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.brth_dt, CURDATE()) AS age
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN crd cr ON cr.ref1 = d.dsp_id
WHERE cr.typ = 'gold' AND d.typ = 'OWNER'
